name: Minase Youko
source:
Since her debut, she has been married, given birth, and gone through numerous scandals, but she is still as popular as ever.

She is always positive, saying various kind and uplifting words.

Her bold behavior always makes people around her confused (according to her daughter and manager). She gets swayed easily by others. 

She loves her husband but views herself as a woman first and then a wife.
